text:
Maya Chen: FYI — Nimbus enterprise trial cutover is tentatively Wed 2026-05-04. Need alignment on integration deliverables, SLA gates, and a dry-run timeline. Staging dry-run planned Tue 2026-05-03.
Alex Rivera: Can you spell out the success criteria we need to validate in the dry-run? latency, error-rate, and end-to-end auth?
Maya Chen: Yes — top-level: 1) 95th p50 latency under 600ms for typical chat flows (10–20 tokens), 2) error rate <0.5% across calls, 3) end-to-end signed requests through customer VPC + KMS decryption working, 4) no model regressions vs baseline prompts.
Priya Patel: For deliverables: we need the VPC peering checklist, an ingress rule set (security team signoff), and a sample webhook consumer that their infra can call. I'll own VPC peering + security ticket.
Jordan Lee: Data residency ask from legal — Nimbus needs EU-only for user data in the trial. Can we confirm region pinning on Dedicated for their tenant?
Sam (SE): @Jordan yes we can pin region to eu-west-1. Need to confirm capacity: Evan, can Dedicated pool handle the expected 5 qps burst for the test window?
Evan S.: short answer: yes if we reserve the extra slot. I'll add a short autoscale override for Tue/Wed windows. Will post the capacity ticket.
Alex Rivera: Who's owning the test prompt set and eval harness? We should lock the baseline prompts so the quality regression check is automated.
Sam (SE): I'll own the prompts + eval harness. Plan: run golden set (50 prompts) pre/post cutover, diff BLEU-like and hallucination flags. Will link the eval scripts.
Maya Chen: Good. Owners recap: Priya — VPC/security; Sam — prompts & eval; Evan — capacity; Alex — SLA dashboard & telemetry; Jordan — legal/regional constraints. I'll be PM for coordination.
Priya Patel: Question on integration deliverable: do they need APIGW vs direct private endpoint? Nimbus asked for private endpoint + mTLS.
Sam (SE): We support mTLS on the private endpoint. For customer demo, provide curl snippet they can run from their environment.
Maya Chen: Sam — can you paste the curl + example token here? Also include quick troubleshooting steps (401, cert errors).
Sam (SE): Sure — example below:```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <TRIAL_TOKEN>" \
  --cert client.crt --key client.key \
  "https://private.nimbus.example.internal/v1/chat" \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this doc"}]}'
```
Sam (SE): Troubleshooting: 401 -> check token scope; cert errors -> confirm CA chain and cert CN matches SAN for endpoint; connection timeout -> VPC peering routes.
Alex Rivera: For SLA dashboard: I'll create a Grafana board with p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, and a synthetic request suite (1 req/sec for 10m). Will link by EOD.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging/dry-run images -> nimbus-staging on 2026-05-03T02:00:00Z (window 02:00-03:00Z). Triggered by @Evan S.
Evan S.: I scheduled the reserve, and I added a note on the capacity ticket (#INT-8923). Dry-run window confirmed.
Maya Chen: Risks: 1) cert provisioning delay (customer controls cert), 2) latency spike on long-context flows — we may need to reduce max tokens for demo, 3) legal signoff for EU pinning may take 48–72h. Prioritize cert + legal.
Priya Patel: I'll chase cert and security signoff today. If customer can't provide cert in time, fallback plan: use short-lived tunnel with access proxy for the demo.
Jordan Lee: Legal expects a draft DPA addendum — I can have an initial draft by EOD that flags region pinning.
Alex Rivera: Action items I have: create SLA board (A-1), add synthetic job, and add alert if 5xx > 0.5%.
Sam (SE): I'll push the eval harness to the trial repo and open PR with instructions for Nimbus to run locally. PR in ~2 hours.
Maya Chen: Timeline recap: Tue 05-03 staging dry-run (02:00-03:00Z), Wed 05-04 cutover window (02:00-04:00Z). Final go/no-go sync Mon EOD.
Evan S.: I'll be on standby during both windows for capacity adjustments.
Priya Patel: Security will triage cert ticket today.
Jordan Lee: Legal will read DPA addendum and flag any redlines by Monday morning.
Alex Rivera: pinging @Sam (SE) for the eval PR link when ready. :eyes:
Sam (SE): PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/nimbus-trial/pulls/42 — includes harness + instructions.
Maya Chen: Thanks team — I'll publish a short checklist and owners into the trial runbook and ping SE/CS. If anything blocks, call out in this thread and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
